source.commit_message: Fix importance-based feature subsampling never sharing pools across estimators (#1141)
source.semantic_effect: The changelog states that estimators drew non-top features independently rather than from a shared round-robin pool, potentially leaving features unseen despite enough combined feature budget; results can change for gini_feature_importance or auto on large wide datasets.
source.benchmark_task: Run an importance-based wide-dataset ensemble where validity of feature coverage requires both a stable ranking and correct shared-pool coverage.
source.execution_status: graph-level pilot; upstream code was not re-executed in this environment

E_POOL.statement: Non-top features are covered across ensemble members

E_RANK.statement: Top-feature ranking used by the ensemble

C_WIDE.statement: Wide-dataset ensemble result is justified only when ranking and cross-estimator feature coverage are both valid
